summary: David prays to be delivered from his enemies—God rules in Jacob unto the ends of the earth.
meta_description: David prays to be delivered from his enemies—God rules in Jacob unto the ends of the earth.
section_headings: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

footnotes.note4_a: OR for no guilt of mine.
footnotes.note10_a: HEB My God, in His loving kindness, shall go before me.
